snippet.title: We Are So Cooked - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

It was an accident. Probably. In this 1–4 player co-op physics-stealth game from Dwarven Brothers and 1312 Interactive, your job is simple: get the body to the exit without anyone noticing. Screaming witnesses, guards, security cameras and sniffer dogs stand in your way, so grab a mop and clean up the trail. It launches on Steam on October 15, 2026, with console versions to follow.
